thread:
Maya Patel: Announcing Hana Ortiz as Director of Dedicated Deployments, start date 2025-09-01. Hana will consolidate Dedicated capacity operations, SLAs, and the private deployment program. We approved two immediate backfills: Senior Dedicated SRE and Manager, Private Deployments. Leah will post reqs tomorrow. Please update org charts and join Hana's intro AMA next Wed 11:00.

Hana Ortiz: Thrilled to join Redwood! First priorities: review Dedicated SLAs, map customer handoffs, and set a hiring plan. I'll host office hours in week one.

Leah Kim: Posting reqs + rubrics tomorrow afternoon. Recruiting note: for the Senior Dedicated SRE, we want candidates with multi-region networking + KMS experience.

Diego Morales: Heads-up: we should freeze any non-essential private-deploy changes for two sprints to avoid churn during the handoff.

people-ops-bot: Maya Patel added event "Hana intro + Dedicated AMA" to calendar Wed 11:00-11:30  attendees: all@company

Evan Carter: Congrats Hana. Quick Q: will the Dedicated roadmaps remain aligned to Platform Performance or will we create a separate roadmap thread?

Hana Ortiz: We'll keep a shared roadmap but create a dedicated cadence for private deployments to speed compliance work. I'll share the proposed cadence in a follow-up.

Priya Natarajan: Operational note: keep SLAs stable during transition. Hana, Priya here  we'll pair on a rollout checklist and a customer-impact matrix by Fri COB.

Sam Gomez: For the Manager, Private Deployments role, do we want customer-facing experience as a hard requirement?

Leah Kim: Recommend customer-facing experience be "preferred" not mandatory; include a short checklist for interviewers to evaluate stakeholder communication.

Maya Patel: Please update team pages/org charts by EOD Friday. If any team needs temporary coverage for oncall or handoffs, DM me and we'll coordinate. Welcome Hana and thanks everyone for prioritizing hires.
